name: One hand on hip
description: A confident everyday stance that works almost anywhere.
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart
Rest one hand on your hip with the elbow pointing out
Let the other arm hang relaxed

name: Hands on hips
description: A strong, square-on pose for bold outfits and colourful walls.
instructions: Face the camera squarely
Put both hands at your waist
Keep your shoulders relaxed and down

name: Cross-legged lean
description: A classic relaxed lean against a pillar, wall or lamp post.
instructions: Lean one shoulder against a pillar or wall
Fold your arms across your chest
Cross one ankle over the other

name: Railing lean
description: An easy, natural pose in front of a view.
instructions: Stand beside a railing or post with the view behind you
Rest one hand on the railing
Let your other hand rest at your side or in a pocket

name: Walk and wave
description: A happy candid walking shot towards the camera.
instructions: Walk slowly towards the camera
Lift one hand near your face as if waving hello
Keep your stride small and natural

name: Easy stroll
instructions: Walk towards the camera at an easy pace
Let your arms swing naturally
The photographer should shoot mid-step

name: Sitting on the steps
description: A grounded seated pose for staircases and steps.
instructions: Sit on a step facing the camera
Plant your feet apart on a lower step
Rest your forearms on your knees

name: Monument steps
description: Sit on the steps of a landmark so it fills the frame behind you.
instructions: Sit on the steps with the building behind you
Stretch one leg down a step and bend the other
Rest your hands on your knees

name: Thinker on a rock
description: A thoughtful seated pose for hikes and viewpoints.
instructions: Sit on a rock or low wall
Rest an elbow on your knee
Prop your chin on your hand and look off to the side

name: Bench lounge
description: A laid-back seated pose for park benches.
instructions: Sit back on a bench and lean into the backrest
Stretch your legs out in front of you
Rest your hands in your lap

name: Hand behind head
description: A relaxed upper-body portrait with a lifted arm.
instructions: Face the camera from the waist up
Raise one hand behind your head
Let the other arm hang loosely

name: Arms to the sky
description: Celebrate a big view or a sunset with both arms up.
instructions: Stand with the view behind you
Raise both arms up and out in a V
Lift your chin a little
